question: In which of the following years was Sanchi declared as a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1989**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** best-preserved complex of Buddhist structures** in India, located on a flat-topped sandstone hill 300 feet (90 metres) above the surrounding countryside, was named a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1989.
 
• The** Sanchi Stupa, designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1989, **is a living testimony of India's aesthetic and architectural past.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Sanchi Stupa i**s one of India's most important Buddhist landmarks, including some of the country's earliest stone buildings.
 
• **Sanchi's Great Stupa is one of India's oldest stone** landmarks of Indian architecture.
 
• It was **comminissed by Ashoka the great in the Third century**, Its core was a modest hemispherical brick building erected over the Buddha's remains.
